evidence.snippet: - `npm run check` fails about twenty tests in a Claude Code session on the maintainer's Mac, in files that spawn processes, send signals or open sockets, with `EPERM`, `EBADF`, `ENOENT` on a stand-in binary, or a five-second timeout, and the same tests fail on a clean `origin/main` there. Cause: the session runs its commands inside Claude Code's own sandbox, which refuses those operations; it is not the load and not the change. A cloud session and CI have no such sandbox. From a host session, run the test files your change touches, say in the report that the whole gate cannot pass there and which files failed on `origin/main` too, and take CI on the exact head as the gate of record. Never read a background command's exit code as the gate's: on [pull request #634](https://github.com/melian-agent/melian/pull/634) the coordinator did, and started a round on a head whose gate had failed.
